Legal

Cookie Policy

What we store on your device, why, and how to turn the optional parts off.

Template notice This page is a working template written for the PressCosmos launch build. It is drafted to be accurate and readable, but it is not legal advice. Have your counsel review it against the jurisdictions you operate in before you rely on it commercially. Last reviewed: 2026-10-30.

1. What cookies we use

We use a small number of first-party cookies and local storage keys. We do not use third-party advertising cookies.

2. The list

NameTypePurposeDuration
presscosmos:themeEssential (local storage)Remembers light or dark modePersistent
presscosmos:consentEssential (local storage)Records your cookie choice so we stop asking12 months
pc_sessionEssentialKeeps you signed in and protects forms against cross-site request forgerySession
pc_analyticsOptionalAggregated, IP-truncated page analytics13 months
pc_referralOptionalAttributes referral traffic from earned coverage90 days

3. Controlling cookies

Essential cookies cannot be disabled because the site cannot function without them. You can decline optional cookies in the consent banner, or change your mind at any time by clearing site data in your browser. Browser-wide cookie blocking is available in every major browser and will not break the core site.

4. Global Privacy Control

We honour the Global Privacy Control signal. If your browser sends GPC, optional analytics and referral cookies are not set.

5. Third parties

Our payment processor and font provider may set their own cookies when you interact with them. Our analytics is first-party and IP-truncated, and we do not run advertising pixels or session-recording tools.

Questions about this policy? Write to support@presscosmos.com or post to PressCosmos Media Network, 2261 Market Street, Suite 4800, San Francisco, CA 94114, US.
